How much do you charge? What is your pricing structure? | Some maintenance tasks we offer as an all-inclusive flat fee, or a flat-fee plus materials. How quickly can you come out? | Our normal service hours are Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm. | We understand the importance of getting you back on track and enjoying your RV again as quickly as possible. For standard service calls, we can typically schedule your appointment within a few business days. | 6. Emergency Service | We do offer emergency service for urgent issues requiring attention outside of our normal hours (Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm). | After-hours service has an additional flat fee of $75. | This is usually best suited for arrival or departure situations needing immediate attention. | Please note: We are not an emergency roadside service. If you've blown a tire or have had some other emergency incident resulting in an abrupt halt to your RV's mobility you should contact your insurance roadside assistance or a dedicated roadside recovery service to address your immediate needs to get you to your destination or at least a safe location. Eric can assess any coach related issues resulting from the incident after your RV has been moved to a safe location (resort, campground, driveway, storage unit, etc) | 7. Do you carry parts on your truck? | Yes, we do try to keep some parts handy for common RV repairs. This allows us to fix many problems in a single visit. If your RV needs specific parts that we don't have in stock, we will order them for you. There is no additional service call fee for any return visit to complete a repair/service in progress - just the applicable labor rate. | *For some flat rate services, part replacements and orders we will require a deposit or payment beforehand. | 8. Can you work with my warranty or insurance company? | Our policy is simple: customers pay us directly for our services and materials at the time the job is completed. | We do not work with warranty or insurance companies at this time. We also do not process pre-approvals or authorizations. | 9. Why should I choose a mobile technician instead of taking my RV to a dealership? | A mobile technician is able to offer three huge benefits: convenience, speed, and personal service. | Convenience: We come to you! You don’t have to waste time and fuel packing up and moving your RV to a shop. We can service your rig at your home, resort, or storage lot. | Speed: The volume handled by a dealership can result in waitlists that are weeks or even months long. We can typically get to you within a few days, solving your problem much faster. | Personal Service: With us, you are speaking directly to the owners and the actual certified technician who will be working on your RV. We promise unparalleled communication and service that is focused completely on you and your rig. | 10. What do I need to do to prepare for your visit? | To help Eric get to work quickly and safely, you can prepare for his visit by: | Making sure your RV is accessible with enough room for him to work around it. | Having your RV connected to any corresponding utility associated with the service call. (water, electric, sewer) | Securing any pets so they are safe and comfortable during the visit. | Having your RV’s make, model, and VIN number handy when you call us or submit your service request online. | Notify your front office/gate house of our appointment.
